m1_plane_1.speaker: malik
m1_plane_1.text: Vanguard One, this is Malik. Two minutes to the drop zone. Final check.

m1_plane_2.speaker: kade
m1_plane_2.text: Chute's good. Rifle's good. Let's get this done.

m1_plane_3.speaker: malik
m1_plane_3.text: The Red Jackals hold a fuel outpost below you. Their commander keeps a laptop with all their supply routes. We want it.

m1_plane_4.speaker: malik
m1_plane_4.text: Ramp is open. Green light. Go, go, go!

m1_freefall.speaker: malik
m1_freefall.text: Watch your altitude, Kade. Open your chute before you hit five hundred metres.

m1_steer.speaker: malik
m1_steer.text: I see you. Steer for the green smoke, west of the outpost.

m1_landed.speaker: malik
m1_landed.text: Good landing. The outpost is to the north east. Stay quiet. If they see you, they'll sound the alarm.

m1_mast_hint.speaker: malik
m1_mast_hint.text: See that radio mast? It's their only link to the valley. Take it down and nobody hears them call for help.

m1_mast_ok.speaker: malik
m1_mast_ok.text: Good. They're deaf now. Find the commander's office. The laptop should be inside.

m1_laptop.speaker: kade
m1_laptop.text: Got the laptop. There's a file here called Dead Hand.

m1_laptop_2.speaker: malik
m1_laptop_2.text: Dead Hand? Bring it home, Kade. Raven is inbound to the landing zone, south of the outpost.

m1_raven.speaker: raven
m1_raven.text: Vanguard One, Raven. Wheels down. Get aboard!

m1_end.speaker: malik
m1_end.text: Nice work. Let's see what Dead Hand really is.

m2_intro_1.speaker: raven
m2_intro_1.text: This is as close as I can get you. Good luck, Vanguard.

m2_intro_2.speaker: malik
m2_intro_2.text: The pass is the only road deeper into the valley. A Red Jackal checkpoint guards it, next to a small village.

m2_intro_3.speaker: malik
m2_intro_3.text: Knock out their radio antenna first. Then find the gate keycard. The checkpoint commander lives in the village.

m2_antenna_ok.speaker: malik
m2_antenna_ok.text: Good. Now the keycard. Try the commander's house.

m2_key_ok.speaker: malik
m2_key_ok.text: The gate controls are in the guard booth. Open it up.

m2_gate.speaker: malik
m2_gate.text: Gate's open. Rauf is waiting on the other side.

m2_rauf_3.speaker: rauf
m2_rauf_3.text: Dead Hand isn't a code name. It's a warhead. And it's already in this valley.

m2_end.speaker: malik
m2_end.text: Then we find it. Good work, both of you.

m3_intro_1.speaker: malik
m3_intro_1.text: That radar on the hill sees every helicopter in the valley. As long as it stands, Raven can't fly.

m3_intro_2.speaker: malik
m3_intro_2.text: Cameras cover the whole station. Shut them down from the control room, then blow the dish.

m3_cams_ok.speaker: malik
m3_cams_ok.text: Nice. They're blind. Get to the radar dish.

m3_c4.speaker: kade
m3_c4.text: Charges set on the dish. Moving away.

m3_radar_down.speaker: malik
m3_radar_down.text: Radar's gone! Raven, you're clear to fly.

m3_raven.speaker: raven
m3_raven.text: Coming in hot, Vanguard. Get to the landing pad!

m3_end.speaker: malik
m3_end.text: Good work, Kade. The valley is open to us now.

g_alarm_malik.speaker: malik
g_alarm_malik.text: They've raised the alarm. Expect more of them.

g_camera_spot.speaker: malik
g_camera_spot.text: Careful, a camera just spotted you!

g_lowhealth.speaker: malik
g_lowhealth.text: Kade, you're hurt. Use a medkit.
